_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NULL, "user_agent" TEXT NULL, "referer" TEXT NULL, "live_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ts', "epg_offset_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "engine_live" TEXT NULL, "engine_vod" TEXT NULL, "account_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "max_connections" INTEGER NULL, "allowed_formats_json" TEXT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "open_generation" INTEGER NULL, "last_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_epg_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "secrets" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "name")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_gen" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "kind", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_items" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "generation", "kind", "category_key", "position")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channels" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "num" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo" TEXT NULL, "tvg_id" TEXT NULL, "tvg_name" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NULL, "is_radio" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_radio" IN (0, 1)), "catchup_mode" TEXT NULL, "catchup_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "catchup_source" TEXT NULL, "tvg_shift_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_gen" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "poster" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "ext" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_gen" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "poster" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "plot" TEXT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_gen" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episodes" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "series_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "ext" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "plot" TEXT NULL, "still" TEXT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NULL, "first_gen" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "detail_cache" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "kind", "key")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_modified" TEXT NULL, "last_fetch_at" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, "programme_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_channels" ("epg_source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES epg_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "display_names_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("epg_source_id", "xmltv_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programmes" ("epg_source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES epg_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stop_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_title" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("epg_source_id", "xmltv_id", "start_utc")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channel_epg_map" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "epg_source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES epg_sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "channel_key")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channel_prefs" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "engine" TEXT NULL, "aspect" TEXT NULL, "audio_lang" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "channel_key")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "kind", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watch_progress" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_key" TEXT NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("finished" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "kind", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recent_channels" ("source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_watched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key")) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX category_items_item ON category_items (source_id, kind, item_key)
CREATE INDEX channels_num ON channels (source_id, num, name_norm, "key")
CREATE INDEX channels_tvg_id ON channels (tvg_id)
CREATE INDEX movies_name ON movies (source_id, name_norm, "key")
CREATE INDEX series_name ON series (source_id, name_norm, "key")
CREATE INDEX episodes_series ON episodes (source_id, series_key, season, number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX epg_sources_url ON epg_sources (source_id, url)
CREATE INDEX channel_epg_map_guide ON channel_epg_map (epg_source_id, xmltv_id)
CREATE INDEX watch_progress_updated ON watch_progress (source_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX recent_channels_time ON recent_channels (source_id, last_watched_at)
